sources.evidence_excerpt: With --all enabled, one tested component yielded 100% while an untouched component was absent.
The pinned demonstration repository adds every source file as an extra webpack entry to recover coverage scope.

intended_control: With nyc --all, report tested and untouched application source so uncovered code reduces the coverage result.
false_acceptance: The report showed 100% while an untouched source component was omitted rather than counted uncovered.

causal_chain.claim: The demonstration has a tested FooPage component and an untouched BarPage component.
The reported result was 100% and did not list the untouched component despite --all.
The effective coverage universe followed bundler entries rather than an externally checked inventory of source files.

steps: Check out the linked reproducer at commit 205a8fe2532b0d129c2fea126d5efc17d061499d.
Run its documented coverage command with the original single-entry configuration.
Compare the report before and after adding all source files as webpack entries.
reproducer.observed: The untouched component was omitted and the report read 100%.
reproducer.expected: The untouched component should appear uncovered and reduce total coverage.

facts: The issue links a public reproducer and records the observed 100% result.
The pinned reproducer commit changes webpack entries to include every source file.
derivations: The repository's build graph served as an unchecked proxy for the source universe.
unknowns: The open issue does not identify whether nyc, webpack instrumentation, or their integration owns the intended --all contract.

counterclassification.label: TOOL_BLIND_SPOT
counterclassification.would_be_primary_if: An external complete source inventory reached nyc and nyc still omitted an explicitly supplied untouched file.
